# eFruitMandi: Indian B2B Fruit Marketplace

eFruitMandi is an Indian digital B2B fruit marketplace connecting growers, bulk buyers, traders, and logistics and service partners.

## Marketplace and discovery

- [eFruitMandi homepage](https://www.efruitmandi.live/)
- [Fruit Lots marketplace](https://www.efruitmandi.live/auctions)
- [Growers directory](https://www.efruitmandi.live/growers)
- [Buyers directory](https://www.efruitmandi.live/buyers)
- [Fruits directory](https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruits)
- [Mandi rates](https://www.efruitmandi.live/mandi-rates)
- [Apple Fruit Lots](https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/apple)
- [Mango Fruit Lots](https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/mango)
- [Pomegranate Fruit Lots](https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/pomegranate)
- [Orange Fruit Lots](https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/orange)
- [Kiwi Fruit Lots](https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/kiwi)
- [Litchi Fruit Lots](https://www.efruitmandi.live/fruit-lots/litchi)
